visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length black hair wearing a white shirt and a bright pink apron is shown from a medium shot, using a large chef's knife to slice a rectangular block of white tofu on a yellow cutting board. The kitchen setting is bright with natural light from a window in the background, showing a stainless steel cooktop and a red pot. White subtitles appear in the center of the frame. (2) The woman’s hands carefully place the sliced tofu squares onto a white cloth draped over a blue tray. She then folds the cloth over the tofu and places a rectangular metal baking pan on top as a weight. The setting remains the same bright indoor kitchen with soft shadows. (3) The scene transitions to the woman washing rice in a silver colander under a stream of running water from a faucet. She then pours the wet white rice into a small pink ceramic pot. Her hands are the main focus as she handles the kitchen tools. (4) The woman uses a knife to trim the stems from brown shiitake mushrooms and slices them into sections on the yellow board. She then halves a bright red tomato, scoops out the seeds with a metal spoon, and finely chops the tomato flesh into a paste. (5) In a small white bowl, the woman combines tomato paste with various liquid condiments poured from glass bottles, including a dark brown sauce and a red sauce. She uses a small wooden spoon to stir the mixture, creating a thick red sauce. (6) On the stovetop, she pours oil from a blue bottle into a black frying pan. She then places the tofu squares, now coated in a thin layer of white flour, into the pan. The tofu is fried until the bottom surface turns a golden-brown, crispy texture, which she monitors by flipping them with purple-tipped chopsticks. (7) After removing the tofu, she adds the sliced mushrooms, shredded orange carrots, and chopped green scallions into the same black pan. She stirs the vegetables with a purple spatula until they are softened. The lighting highlights the steam rising from the hot pan. (8) The fried tofu squares are added back into the pan with the vegetables, and the prepared red sauce is poured over them. The mixture is stirred gently until the tofu is evenly coated in the bubbling red sauce. (9) A handful of fresh green basil leaves is added to the pan, and the woman stirs them in until they wilt slightly. The dish is then plated over a bowl of white rice. The woman takes a bite using wooden chopsticks, looks at the camera, and smiles expressively, indicating enjoyment. The scene concludes with a call-to-action text overlay showing her social media handles.

(18) [Subtitle]: 重物移開... (19) [Subtitle]: 盤子上放一點麵粉. (20) [Subtitle]: 把豆腐均勻的沾上一點麵粉 接著拍掉多餘的粉... (21) [Subtitle]: (豆腐沾麵粉煎，可以比較容易吸收醬汁). (22) [Subtitle]: 開中火加熱 鍋子裡加入較多的橄欖油. (23) [Subtitle]: 等油熱了，放入豆腐進來煎. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, rhythmic acoustic guitar track in a major key with a bright, energetic tone. A female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a friendly, welcoming intonation. A sharp, percussive 'tack' sound occurs as a knife hits a wooden board, followed by rapid cutting sounds. (2) A transition sound is followed by the 'shhh' of running water splashing into a colander, accompanied by the metallic 'tink' of the colander hitting a pot. The background music maintains its steady, cheerful tempo as the narrator continues her instructions. (3) New cutting sounds emerge with a deeper, hollower 'thud' as mushrooms are sliced. A wet 'squish' and 'thud' indicate the cutting of tomatoes. The vocal intensity remains moderate and conversational, fitting the instructional nature of the content. (4) A metallic 'clink' and 'tink' of a spoon stirring in a ceramic bowl are heard as the sauce is prepared. The music features a light piano melody layered over the guitar. The sound of a liquid 'glug' occurs as sauce is poured from a bottle. (5) A loud, continuous sizzling sound 'psshhhh' enters as tofu is placed in hot oil. This is accompanied by the rhythmic 'scrape' of a metal spatula or chopsticks against a frying pan. The music swells slightly in volume but remains under the voice. (6) Repeated 'tack' sounds occur as various vegetables are added to the pan. The sizzling becomes slightly more muffled and 'wet' as sauce is poured in. The narrator's tone rises in pitch, conveying excitement as the dish nears completion. (7) A light 'rustle' sound occurs as basil leaves are handled. This is followed by a mechanical 'crack-clack' of a pepper mill. The music reaches a concluding phrase. The final sequence includes the 'clink' of a bowl and chopsticks, followed by soft chewing and smacking sounds, and a positive vocal exclamation 'Hao chi!'.
